_about: James Aitken Wylie (1808-1890), Free Church of Scotland minister: The History of Protestantism (London, Paris and New York: Cassell, Petter and Galpin, undated, 3 vols, illustrated), from the Waldenses and Wycliffe to the Covenanters. Volume numbers read off each title page. Named james-wylie so other Wylies cannot collide. Added 2026-10-03: The Papacy (1852), Daybreak in Spain ([1870]) and Disruption Worthies, the Free Church's memorial of 1843 with biographical sketches by many hands, which he edited and introduced (new edition, [1881]). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

wylie-history-protestantism-1: The History of Protestantism (London: Cassell, Petter and Galpin, undated), vol. 1
wylie-history-protestantism-2: The History of Protestantism (London: Cassell, Petter and Galpin, undated), vol. 2
wylie-history-protestantism-3: The History of Protestantism (London: Cassell, Petter and Galpin, undated), vol. 3
wylie-papacy-1852: The Papacy: its History, Dogmas, Genius and Prospects, the Evangelical Alliance prize essay on Popery (Edinburgh: Johnstone and Hunter, 1852)
wylie-daybreak-in-spain: Daybreak in Spain, or Sketches of Spain and its New Reformation (London: Cassell, Petter, and Galpin, undated; the catalogue gives [1870])
wylie-disruption-worthies: Disruption Worthies: a Memorial of 1843, with an historical sketch of the Free Church of Scotland, ed. Wylie, new edition (Edinburgh: Thomas C. Jack, undated; the catalogue gives 1881)
